name: kawaii_hd
notes: S4_hd sprite face (r15), forked from kawaii_v2 so legacy variants keep their cels. front / profile unchanged. three_quarter (r15 user feedback 'SE far eye too close / weird'): the far eye is the SAME HEIGHT as the near eye (2x3, narrower not shorter) with a 1-px catchlight on its inner (light-side) column, matching the near eye's light; no outward lash wing (foreshortened) and no blush. profile: same cels as kawaii_v2 but drawn 1 row lower (origin row 0): the camera looks down 16 deg, so the front-view eyes sit lower than the nose-tip anchor; the old profile eye sat ~1 px above the S/SE eye line and the longer r15 bangs covered its lash. Placement (pipeline/face.py apply_face_eyes, render.face_eyes): 2-px nose bridge, >= 2 px far cheek (contour_far), mouth pulled under the bridge (mouth_bias). Face designer r10. Coords relative to the anchor pixel (face front on the eye line). front: cols -4..4, rows -1..+2 (bangs cover row -2 in pitched frames); 3/4 and profile drawn facing screen-right (mirrored for left views). 3/4 (r13 perspective fix): near eye lash -6..-4, iris -5..-4; 2px nose-bridge gap at -3..-2; far eye 2x2 at -1..0 with >= 2 skin px of far cheek beyond it, mouth at -1 (no lash or catchlight, at least 1 skin px to the edge). profile: eye column -2, catchlight -3 (back), nose -1. Shape family: ^ joyful, > < squint, lowered-lid determined.
